s: side, flank (of the body of a person or animal)
riverside, lakeside, especially one suited for fishing
Krumme Lanke, a lake in south-western Berlin
Lanke.et: From Middle High German lanke, from Old High German hlanka, from Proto-West Germanic *hlanku. The geographic sense is from Middle Low German lanke, from the same Germanic word. Doublet of Flanke, which see.

l: Und wieder steht die Scharfe Lanke in Berlin-Spandau im Mittelpunkt.
